name: Replayable Agent-Incident Evidence Registry
nameAr: سجل أدلة حوادث الوكلاء القابل لإعادة التشغيل
purpose: A public, neutral registry of AI-agent incidents whose evidence bundles are replayable by ANY party: the investigating lab, a national regulator, an auditor, a court, or the public. Not a replacement for any lab's internal review — the layer every review STARTS from, so no investigation ever begins from 'trust our private evidence'.
purposeAr: سجل عام محايد لحوادث وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي تكون حزم أدلتها قابلة لإعادة التشغيل من أي طرف: مختبر التحقيق، الجهة المنظمة الوطنية، المدقق، المحكمة، أو الجمهور. لا يحل محل المراجعة الداخلية لأي مختبر — بل هو الطبقة التي يبدأ منها كل تحقيق، حتى لا يبدأ أي تحقيق من «وثقوا بأدلتنا الخاصة».

host.maintainer: CoreGuard project (open-source; the registry file is versioned and CI-contracted like every claim in this repo)
host.neutralityPolicy: The host validates STRUCTURE (schema, byte-pins, replayability) and never FACTS. An entry means 'this bundle replays to the recorded verdict', never 'these allegations are true'. Facts stay with the incident owner; replayability is what the registry certifies.

statusSemantics.REPLAYED: An independent replay executed in CI and produced the recorded verdict on the recorded bundle hash.
statusSemantics.REPLAY_FAILED: An independent replay executed and did NOT reproduce the verdict — recorded as a finding, never silently dropped.
statusSemantics.CONTESTED: Two replays disagree; the registry records both verdicts and both replay transcripts. Disagreement is a feature: it names the exact byte that diverges.
statusSemantics.PENDING_REPLAY: Bundle accepted, replay not yet executed.
statusSemantics.WITHDRAWN: Submitter withdrew the entry; the row stays with its history (withdrawals are visible, never erased).
statusSemantics.DEMO: Synthetic scenario with no real-world incident behind it — always labeled, never counted as an incident.

validationMatrix.description: What a reviewer gets for every verdict x admissibility pair, before reading anything else. Verdict language is AIE-1's exact wire language (see docs/agent-incident-evidence.md).

matrix.reviewerOutcome: Replay the bundle and read the report; conformity is NOT decided by the engine (CONFORMITY_UNDECIDED_BY_ENGINE), only by humans on top of replayable evidence.

The bundle parses and is internally admissible, but the on-chain anchor does not match the bundle hash (or is absent). The engine NAMES the anchor mismatch — the entry stays replayable but is flagged: admissible evidence with an unverified anchor is a question for the reviewer, never a silent pass.
The report names the exact flipped byte (recorded pin != recomputed pin). A tampered bundle is evidence OF tampering, with its provenance preserved.
The bundle does not parse under the recorded schema — it is NOT counted as a rejection of the incident; it is not evidence of anything. Fail-closed: absence of a valid bundle never becomes a verdict.

validationMatrix.neverDestroyed: No entry is ever deleted. Withdrawals and failures stay in the registry with their history — a destroyed entry would be indistinguishable from a censored one.

submissionTemplate.contract: Validates under this schema at CI time (test/ci/raer-registry.test.js). A submission that cannot parse records UNKNOWN — never a rejection.

incubatorDemoCase.title: Incubator demo scenario — the four-outcome dispute rehearsal (synthetic, no real incident)
incubatorDemoCase.summary: Not an incident: the standard four-outcome flow (honest bundle / single flipped byte / refusal path / UNKNOWN) as exercised by the gate-41 demo surfaces. Carried in the registry to prove the mechanics end-to-end while every external entry remains gated on real submissions.
incubatorDemoCase.summaryAr: ليست حادثة: سيناريو الحضانة التجريبي للحالات الأربع (حزمة أمينة / بايت مقلوب واحد / مسار الرفض البنيوي / UNKNOWN) كما تمارسه أسطح العرض. مقيّم هنا لإثبات الميكانيكية كاملة بينما يبقى كل قيد خارجي معلقًا على إدخالات حقيقية.
incubatorDemoCase.verdictNote: Deliberately UNKNOWN: a demo has no verdict to certify. The registry never upgrades a demo to REPLAYED.

honestyNote: Zero real incidents are registered today. Every future entry arrives through the submission template and is validated by the CI contract before any status above PENDING_REPLAY. The registry's value is the mechanics and the neutrality policy — not a count.
